name: PipraPay Payment Gateway
description: Seamlessly accept bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Cards, and multi-currency payments via PipraPay with instant webhook validation and auto-settlement.
author: PipraPay Labs

adminSettingsPage.title: PipraPay Gateway Settings
adminSettingsPage.description: Configure PipraPay API credentials, webhook verification keys, sandbox/live mode, supported currencies, and connection diagnostics.

options.label: Sandbox (Simulation & Test Checkout)
options.description: Safe test environment for simulated bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and card transactions.

options.label: Live (Production Transactions)
options.description: Connect to live PipraPay API for real customer transactions.

settingsSchema.label: PipraPay API Base URL
settingsSchema.description: Base REST API endpoint. Use https://sandbox.piprapay.com/api for testing or https://piprapay.com/api for production.

settingsSchema.label: PipraPay API Key
settingsSchema.description: Confidential API Key issued by PipraPay Merchant Dashboard. Kept securely in the server vault.

settingsSchema.label: Webhook / Signature Secret Key
settingsSchema.description: Secret key used for HMAC-SHA256 verification of incoming webhook IPN notifications.

options.label: BDT (৳ Bangladeshi Taka - bKash, Nagad, Rocket)

settingsSchema.label: Transaction Surcharge / Processing Fee (%)
settingsSchema.description: Optional merchant processing fee percentage added to customer total at checkout (0 for no surcharge).

settingsSchema.label: Set as Default Payment Gateway
settingsSchema.description: Automatically pre-selects PipraPay in customer checkout modals.

settingsSchema.label: Display Priority Order
settingsSchema.description: Ordering priority in checkout modal list (1 = top).

settingsSchema.label: IPN Webhook Listener URL
settingsSchema.description: Copy this endpoint into your PipraPay Merchant Webhook settings.

settingsSchema.label: Status Mapping Rules (JSON)
settingsSchema.description: Maps gateway IPN statuses to platform transaction ledger statuses.

settingsSchema.label: Enable Diagnostic & Webhook Audit Logging
settingsSchema.description: Persists all gateway requests, webhook deliveries, and API errors to the central payment audit ledger.

changes: Initial release of the standalone PipraPay Payment Gateway Add-on Plugin.
Integrated bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Cards, and multi-currency checkout redirect flow.
Full server-side secret management with HMAC-SHA256 webhook validation.
Idempotency protection preventing duplicate charge completions.
Full support for memberships, subscriptions, wallet funding, and tips.
